answer_1.quote: In recent years, Large Language Models (LLMs) have been employed for the task of response generation in human-machine dialogues.

answer_2.quote: We conduct a comparative study on the impact of in-context learning and fine-tuning to adapt LLMs for dialogues... Table reports the perplexity of Llama2 C and Mistral I on the test set of each dialogue type.

answer_4.quote: We recruited 75 annotators on the Prolific platform, and we assigned 5 dialogues to each annotator.
answer_4.guideline: We evaluate the responses using their protocol and three of their dimensions: Contextualization: the response includes explicit or implicit references to the dialogue history (ODD, KGD, TOD) or the gold knowledge (QA); Appropriateness: the response is coherent and makes sense as a continuation of the dialogue; Correctness: the response is grammatically and syntactically correct.
